notes: Wix site; images pulled at original resolution from static.wixstatic.com (part before /v1/). Run by the Marin County Office of Education. Lodging page: four lodges with semi-private 2-5 bed rooms (linens, central heat, Wi-Fi, adjacent bathrooms); 13 cabins with 7-9 bunks (some with private bath, others use a bathhouse); two larger bunkhouses; camping. Conference-center contact on the site is 415-491-6603 / jparker@marinschools.org (base data lists 415-491-6600). Floor plans/maps page exists (floor-plans-maps). The site has no exterior photos of the cabins/lodges themselves; the best establishing shots are the valley views.
